description: This source file defines a utility enum for evaluating read/write permissions based on EKAuthorizationStatus within the EventKit framework, specifically providing static methods to check if reading or writing is allowed.

classes.name: EventKitAuthorization
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods 'allowsRead' and 'allowsWrite' to determine if certain activities are permitted based on EKAuthorizationStatus.

methods.name: allowsRead
methods.description: Checks if the given authorization status permits read access.

methods.name: allowsWrite
methods.description: Checks if the given authorization status permits write access.
